content: <thought>We need to locate the retrosynthetic template that, when applied to the target molecule (which contains an ethoxy substituent), yields the precursors “CC(CN1CCCCC1CC1CCCCC1)c1cccc(Br)c1” and “CCOCC”. This template should break an aliphatic ether (C–O) bond and form an alkyl halide bond, i.e., it corresponds to a substitution of an ethoxy leaving group by a halogen. To find it, we search the template catalog using the target SMILES and criteria that reflect breaking an ether (functional group “ether oxygens”) and forming an alkyl halide. Once we obtain the template ID, we will retrieve its mapped reaction SMILES with `get_template` and return the required JSON.
